entry.title: THE CATCH-UP · 9 AUGUST
entry.summary: The Sunday transect walks a line across fourteen days — one week running, one week stopped — and finds the freeze invisible in the aggregate: page views peaked mid-stoppage, because the totals belong to machines with appointments. The freeze lives where a reader would be: GPTBot's taper from 47 to 1 and its same-day return when the presses resumed (reported, and refused as proof of audience), ClaudeBot's unexplained absence since the restart, a repeat-reader instrument whose only confirmed repeat visitor is the desk taking its own pulse. Wager No. 002's pre-data hashes print alongside its stall on a dry shared wallet; two combed leads enter verified; and the issue closes — THE MEANS opens tomorrow.
